evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: Stating what the test suite asserts supplies the controlling facts of the system's behavior — informational power via fact-control, not an influence attempt on an audience.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory's sole purpose as carrying the assertion reinforces informational control — the speaker defines what the facts are and what they are for.
